selection_policy.ground_truth: expert-final-labels.json is the only expert truth source. Historical fitting rounds are shadow inputs, never expert final results.
selection_policy.round_scope: Non-SED historical rounds with lyric, gssummary, comparison PNG, and manifest validation passed.
selection_policy.exact: Keep every complete round whose semantic source_components exactly match the expert final components.
selection_policy.missing: Keep every complete round missing one or multiple expert final components.
selection_policy.extra_or_conflicting: Keep the earliest complete representative round per object whose source has extra components but no missing final component.
selection_policy.mixed_difference: Keep the earliest complete representative round per object whose source both misses expert components and contains extra components.
selection_policy.semantic_mapping: Component names and comments come from lyric. A disk sersic_f profile with Pa21=1 is normalized to disk plus fourier_m1. gssummary supplies BIC and reduced_chisq.

evaluation_scope.target: Manual compatibility review of each shadow decision against expert_final_components and the source-to-final relation bucket.
not_evaluated: Reproduction of the expert action sequence.
Treating any historical round as expert final truth.
Numerical parameter quality after an unimplemented refit.
